niche.habitat: Drifting Isles exosphere and surface; drifts attached to or within 1 km of the isle during F3 flybys.
niche.diet: Interstellar dust, PAHs, radiolytic volatiles, accreted organics; filters via magnetic sail.
niche.active: Only during molecular cloud passages or near radiogenic heat vents; stasis otherwise.

body: Gigantic (~150 m span), translucent ether-membrane with embedded magnetite filaments; biradial symmetry; slow pulsing internal glow.

links: Captures charged ISM dust and PAHs
Requires magnetic field torque to orient
Conductive protein filaments align with GCR flux
GCR ionization creates charge separation in sail matrix

skill.effect: Unfurls a magnetic field that pulls 3 resource tokens from the environment into a 2m radius; also aligns player to magnetic north.

chains.weakness: High radiation spikes disrupt sail alignment, causing resource loss and stun.
observe: Dust sparks fly toward the sail as it hums.
Magnetite filaments glow faintly blue along the edges.
Movement is a slow, drifting arc with no visible propulsion.

journal.en: It eats the dead wind and flashes its hunger in the dark.

plausibility.summary: Reframe accretion as (1) passive sail interception during F3 cloud passages when grain flux spikes, plus (2) electrostatic retention on a radiolysis-charged ether sail; magnetite only aligns the sheet to galactic B-field and local charge gradients. Skill pulls nearby tokens already in ballistic range on the isle, not deep ISM. Say highly speculative for any macroscopic field-modulated collector.

links: Shields internal brine from GCR dose

skill.effect: Player absorbs 50% of incoming radiation damage for 6 turns; Velafrío gains a temporary shield token.

chains.weakness: Absorbed dose must be vented; venting reveals a chemical plume.
observe: Surface glows with trapped Cerenkov-like blue luminescence.
Membrane ripples slowly to redistribute pigment granules.
Tiny cracks in the ice heal as fluid seeps and seals.

journal.en: A cathedral of glass that drinks the universe's poison.

plausibility.summary: Describe the membrane as a sparse colonial veil: living pigment nodes linked by glass-state matrix, active only during flybys; Radiolytic Soak vents dose into pigment granules and brine sinks, matching weakness plume (F11 ballistic). Mark highly speculative for cathedral-scale macrostructure.

skill.effect: Emits a chemical pulse that attracts passive creatures within 10m and reveals hidden resources for 4 turns.

chains.weakness: Flash consumes stored energy; Velafrío enters stasis for 2 turns after.
observe: Sudden burst of IR/UV light with no heat.
Scent molecules travel in straight lines to player.
Stomach fluids mix, causing a visible reaction.

journal.en: It speaks in straight lines and sudden light.

plausibility.summary: Call it chemiluminescence (not heatless 'bioluminescence' unless enzymes are named). Pulses are rare, mate/colony sync only; Social range 10 m is honest in vacuum. Highly speculative as macroscopic beacon.

chains.weakness: Cannot enter tight spaces; high energy cost makes it slow.
observe: Shadow blocks the player's view for seconds.

journal.en: To be small is to starve in the long dark.

relations.note: (council kind 'mutualism') Velafrío drops radiolytic waste and dormant spores; Polvorín cleans the sail and returns thawed brine.
(council kind 'mutualism') Polvorín cleans Velafrío's sail and provides thawed brine; Velafrío drops waste and spores.

body_plan.origin: Evolved from flattened brine-colonies that unfolded their membranes to catch matter flux during rare flybys; membranes thickened to shield radiation.

temperament: Apathetic giant; indifferent to small fauna; accidental mutualist; drifts on ballistic trajectories.
secrets: Velafrío carries dormant spores from molecular clouds to the isle.
Its sail membrane can be harvested for radiation shielding.
The pulsing glow matches the resonance of deep brine pockets.
moments: A shadow swallows the starless sky; the Velafrío opens its gossamer sail, and suddenly the void is filled with the silent spark of accreted dust, painting the dark with transient constellations of life.

journal.en: It drifts like a cathedral of glass, eating the dead wind.
Its sail catches the radiation, and for a moment, the dark is alive.
